description:
Recorded June 30, 2026, 2pm Pacific. Live from AI Engineer World's Fair! Fable is still banned (as of recording time, ahem). Advice: Build for agents. We’re still talking about loops, but which loops? And more receipts are demanded.

CHAPTERS
